settings.title: Setting references
settings.intro: Pick a setting, edit its sentence, then copy it into your image tool.
settings.separate: References, not 3D backgrounds. Use them with your layout PNG and actor references. No image generation here.

scene.title: Build a scene
scene.intro: Arrange up to 5 stand-in figures and save a layout image to upload alongside your actor references in an AI tool (no AI generation here).
scene.unavailable: 3D could not load. You can still use actor references and the Guide.
scene.storageUnavailable: Local saving is unavailable. Keep this page open or save a PNG.
scene.failed: Could not save the PNG. Try again.
scene.gestures: Drag a figure to move it. Drag empty space to orbit; pinch or scroll to zoom. Use the fields for precise placement.
scene.promptIntro: Upload the layout and each actor’s reference sheet. Match the numbers, names and coloured bands below. Use each actor’s face and outfit from their sheet, not the grey mannequin.
scene.approximate: Figures are generic stand-ins, not 3D actor models. Builds are approximate (unlisted heights start at 175 cm), and edits only affect this draft.
c3.voteNotPromise: Current votes help set production priorities. Leading or tying is not a promise of promotion or a release date.
c3.noVotes: No votes yet. Cast the first vote!
c3.voteRoster: Meet the new faces and vote
c3.creator: Creator work

c2.ownerOnly: Private review desk. Every action is authorized by the backend for the current Owner.
c2.saved: Action saved. Reloading the current record below.
c2.pauseScope: Pausing blocks new submissions and upload targets. Reading, reports, review and cleanup remain available.
c2.confirmPause: Pause new submissions now? Existing published works stay visible.
c2.confirmResume: Resume new submissions with the current limits?
c2.approvalNotTrust: Approval applies only to this revision. It does not grant trust to the author.
c2.revokeHelp: Revoking trust sends future submissions to review. It does not remove previously published works.
c2.notTrusted: This author is not currently trusted.
c.pendingDraftHint: Another draft in this tab is still saving. Finish that draft before editing a different work.
c.noTranscript: The creator has not provided a transcript.
c.title: Community
c.draftInvalidHint: We could not save this yet. Check the title and actor version. If both look right, send us the request number below. Your files are still here.
c.uncertain: Connection interrupted. Your submission request was saved—please don’t create a duplicate.
c.actorLimit: Choose 1–16 actors. The version is saved with your work.
c.videoHelp: Only links from the listed platforms. No video file uploads.
c.audioLimit: Up to {seconds} seconds (duration is checked on upload).
c.dailyLimits: Daily limit: {posts} posts · {mib} MiB total (resets daily at 00:00 UTC).
c.metadata: Images are automatically re-saved before upload to strip metadata (original files must also fit the size limit).
c.validating: Uploaded. Checking files now (not published yet).
c.mediaLocked: Uploaded files are locked to this draft. Check the status before retrying, or start a new draft to use different files.
c.submitHelp: First submissions need review. The returned status, not this button, decides whether a work is public.
c.submitted: Submitted! Check the current status below.
c.externalFallback: Cannot play here? Open the original. Private, removed or region-restricted videos may not embed.
c.mediaUnavailable: A media preview is not available yet. No placeholder is a delivered file.
c.confirmDelete: Remove this work from public view? File cleanup will continue in the background.
c.deleted: Removed from public view; files are being cleaned up.
c.error.INVALID_INPUT: Check the fields and try again.
c.error.INVALID_CURSOR: This list expired. Refresh the page to load it again.
c.error.AUTH_REQUIRED: Sign in with your Swimmer account to continue.
c.error.OWNER_REQUIRED: Only the Owner can use this review desk.
c.error.ORIGIN_NOT_ALLOWED: Community features aren’t enabled for this address.
c.error.METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED: This request method is not supported. Reload before trying again.
c.error.POST_UNAVAILABLE: This work is not available to you.
c.error.MEDIA_UNAVAILABLE: This media is not available to you.
c.error.OPERATION_UNAVAILABLE: Could not check the original request yet. Your request ID is kept when you retry.
c.error.REVISION_CONFLICT: This work was updated elsewhere. Reload the latest version before editing.
c.error.IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: This request doesn’t match the saved draft. Reload the saved work first.
c.error.INVALID_STATE: This action is not available in the current state. Refresh its status.
c.error.UPLOAD_EXPIRED: The upload link expired. Refresh the status before uploading again.
c.error.FILE_TOO_LARGE: The file exceeds the current size limit.
c.error.POST_MEDIA_LIMIT: Check the permitted number of files for this work.
c.error.UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA: This media format is not supported.
c.error.MEDIA_INVALID: This file couldn’t be verified. Please try an intact file in a supported format.
c.error.AUDIO_TOO_LONG: The audio exceeds the current duration limit.
c.error.VIDEO_URL_UNSUPPORTED: Use a supported HTTPS video link, not embed code.
c.error.RIGHTS_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED: Confirm both credit and usage rights before submitting.
c.error.POST_QUOTA_EXCEEDED: Your daily submission allowance is used up.
c.error.UPLOAD_QUOTA_EXCEEDED: Your daily upload allowance is used up.
c.error.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Wait before trying again.
c.error.SUBMISSIONS_PAUSED: Submissions are paused. Reading, reports and review remain available.
c.error.COMMUNITY_UNAVAILABLE: Community is not working right now. Try again later.
c.error.PROCESSING_UNAVAILABLE: The file could not upload yet. Your work is not published.
